class: State set early in a form was assumed to still hold at the end: the agent re-checked the fields it had typed before pressing the button, but not the boxes it had ticked
symptom: Create Account was pressed and Workday answered 'Please check the box to continue': the consent box was clear at the press, though the agent had ticked it.
root_cause: Workday redraws the form as it is filled. fill_create_account_form re-typed the email and passwords right before the press but never read the ticked boxes back, so a box a redraw had cleared went unnoticed.
why_tests_missed: Fixtures were static: a box ticked stayed ticked. None cleared state between the tick and the press.
fix: The ids of the boxes the agent ticks are remembered; just before the press each is read back and ticked again if clear; one that will not stay ticked stops the run with that reason.
prevention: Before a non-idempotent press, read back every piece of state the agent set (fields and boxes), not just the ones known to be fragile; and test with a page that changes state between the set and the press.
